valuation.method: Forward EPS x P/E: FY2027 non-GAAP diluted EPS viewed at the 12-month target date (Nov 2027), times a justified P/E. USD listing (NASDAQ), no ADR conversion, no FX. Anchor: nine-month 2026 non-GAAP diluted EPS of $8.30 (reported Oct 20, 2026), plus a Q4 2026 assumption of about $3.10 (not guided by the company), so FY2026E is about $11.40. Full-year 2026 guidance is da Vinci procedure growth of 14-15% (closer to the midpoint), non-GAAP gross margin of 68.7-69.3% and non-GAAP opex growth of 11-13%; no EPS or operating-margin guidance and no 2027 outlook were given. FY2027 EPS is my assumption. Diluted shares were 351.6M in Q3 2026 and falling on buybacks.

bear.driver: Da Vinci procedure growth slips toward the low end of the 14-15% range and tariffs and pricing pressure hold gross margin near the bottom of its range; opex growth absorbs most of the revenue growth, so EPS grows only about 4%, and the multiple de-rates as competition from rival systems weighs on the premium.

base.driver: Da Vinci procedures keep growing near the 14.5% midpoint and Ion grows faster; gross margin holds around 69% and opex growth stays within 11-13%, so EPS grows about 13%, in line with 2026 non-GAAP EPS growth of roughly 25% slowing as buybacks and margin gains fade.

bull.driver: Procedure growth runs above the guided range with faster placement growth (546 systems in Q3, up 28% from 427) and margin expansion from the gross margin raise; EPS grows about 23% and the stock holds a premium multiple as the installed base compounds.

valuation.implied_by_close: At base FY2027 EPS of $12.90 the $443.59 close implies 34.4x (38.9x the FY2026E EPS of $11.40). The Yahoo Finance aggregate mean target of $486.57 (30 analysts, not used in the base case) implies about 37.7x base EPS, or about $13.80 of EPS at 36x.
valuation.sensitivity: One turn of P/E moves the base target by $12.90 (about 2.9% of the close); $0.10 of FY2027 EPS moves it by about $3.60 at 36x.
valuation.watch_metric: Worldwide da Vinci procedure growth against the 14-15% guide (Q3 2026: da Vinci +14%, Ion +31%), together with non-GAAP gross margin inside 68.7-69.3% and opex growth inside 11-13%. Base case requires EPS growth near 13% in 2027.
valuation.next_disclosure: Q4 and full-year 2026 results, expected around late January 2027 (date not sourced); the first point at which the company is likely to give 2027 framing.

analyst_notes: Only one named analyst call with a dated source falls in the window: Joanne Wuensch (Citigroup) maintained Buy with a $500 target on Aug 13, 2026, 13% above the close, and that target has no documented 12-month horizon, so it stays out of the weighted target. Named notes after the Oct 20 Q3 beat (for example a Leerink $503 Outperform, dated Oct 21 or Oct 27 by different sources, and an RBC cut from $575 to $550) could not be confirmed from a primary source with consistent prior targets or dates, so they are excluded. The aggregate mean of $486.57 sits about 10% above the base case and implies roughly 37.7x base EPS, so the gap is mainly a multiple question: reaching it at 36x needs about $13.80 of FY2027 EPS, roughly 7% above the base model. Coverage is thin for a 30-analyst stock, and the sample cannot support a recency-weighted consensus.
